name: Poles (Polish National Government of the November Uprising)

predecessors.name: Congress Poland
predecessors.text: the Kingdom of Poland of 1815 (Congress Poland), 128,500 km2 on the Congress Poland page; Cliopatria's 'Poles' shape is 113,460 km2

successors.name: Russian Empire
successors.text: the Kingdom of Poland re-occupied by Russia; 'Russian-occupied Poland would lose its autonomy and become an integral part of the Russian Empire' under the Organic Statute of 1832

ledger.x: 29 November 1830: the November Uprising begins in Warsaw.
November 1830: the Kingdom of Poland leaves Russian rule.
February 1831: the Russian army fights its way into the Kingdom.
5 October 1831: the Polish army lays down its arms.
October 1831: the Kingdom is back under Russia.

wars.name: November Uprising
wars.outcome: The rising was crushed after an 11-month campaign: Warsaw fell on 6-8 September 1831, the army crossed into Prussia on 5 October 1831; the Organic Statute of 1832 abolished the Kingdom's constitution, army and legislative assembly.

certainty.note: A war-time territory: the Kingdom of Poland's 1815 frontier, held until the Russian advance of 1831.
